ValidationRule.description: To close a case that has Classification field as "Incidencia" , Typology is "Pago comercial" and Incident with economic impact "checked" must have the following fields completed: Approver 01 and Approver 02
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.CIB_Bypass__c.CIB_skip_validationrule__c, !$Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Admin__c, $Setup.CIB_User_Org__c.CIB_Is_Service__c, ISPICKVAL(SER_Business_Case_Type__c, "GM"), ISPICKVAL( SER_Classification__c , "Incidencia"), ISPICKVAL( SER_Type_GM__c , "Pago comercial"), SER_Incident_with_economic_impact__c = TRUE, OR( ISPICKVAL(Status,"Closed"), SER_Close__c = True ), OR( ISBLANK( SER_Authorizer_1__c ), ISBLANK( SER_Authorizer_2__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: To close a case that has Classification field as "Incidencia" , Typology is "Pago comercial" and Incident with economic impact "checked" must have the following fields completed: Approver 01 and Approver 02
